{{Top|leg}}
An '''Imperial cargo voucher''' was an official document that allowed [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] to transport restricted goods. [[Forger (profession)/Legends|Forgers]] were known to produce copies of Imperial cargo vouchers to allow individuals to transport restricted goods without the correct permits.
